title: Published Envelope Dataset
description: Search Representation corpus. Contract from ENVELOPE_DATASET_SCHEMA_SSOT + PUBLISHED_DATASET_SSOT. EnvelopeRecord Required fields only. No Modal, Strategy body, Cartesian, Geometry, Ranking.

datasetIdentity.description: Optional logical Dataset Identity for Package/Manifest reference. Not an EnvelopeRecord field.

records.description: EnvelopeRecord[]. Strategy : EnvelopeRecord = 1:1 (logical Identity Rule; uniqueness not enforced by JSON Schema).

PointSet.description: Logical Set of Points. N >= 1. Duplicate removal is producer concern.

StrategyRef.description: Logical Reference to Strategy. Concrete ID format is Architecture AR-16 undecided.

EnvelopeRecord.description: Search Representation for one Strategy. Exactly four Required fields. No Modal / Strategy body.

target.description: Fixed Authoring Target. Exactly one Point. No Target sampling.

cueSet.description: Cue axis samples (Cue→Impact 1/3). Endpoints included by Sampling Policy (not re-validated here).

secondSet.description: Second axis samples (C3→Line of Score). Endpoints included by Sampling Policy (not re-validated here).
